name: Render: Concept Explorer
description: Renders concept-db data as interactive UI. Accepts concept graph data (nodes + edges) and related concepts, renders them using graph and table primitives. Works with live concept-db impulse data or explicit JSON variables.

tasks.description: Render the concept name header and breadcrumb

prompt.template:
Render a header for a concept explorer view using render_ui.

Concept name: {{conceptName}}
Description: {{conceptDescription}}

Call render_ui once with:
- primitive.type: container
- primitive.layout: horizontal
- primitive.padding: 16
- primitive.align: center
- primitive.gap: 12
- primitive.naked: true
- primitive.children:
  1. A badge (variant: info, text: 'Concept')
  2. A text heading with the concept name
  3. If description is provided: a text body with the description (use style: muted)
- animation: none
- position.mode: flow

variables.name: conceptName
variables.description: Name of the concept to explore

tasks.description: Render the concept relationship graph using the graph primitive

prompt.template:
Render a concept relationship graph using render_ui.

Concept graph data (JSON): {{conceptGraphJson}}

The data has this structure:
```
{
  nodes: Array<{ id: string, label: string, color?: string, size?: number }>,
  edges: Array<{ source: string, target: string, label?: string, weight?: number }>
}
```

If {{conceptGraphJson}} is empty or unavailable, generate a small example graph:
- 5 nodes representing concepts related to {{conceptName}}
- 4-6 edges showing relationships
- Use colors: primary concept #2563eb, related #7c3aed, supporting #0891b2

Call render_ui with:
- primitive.type: graph
- primitive.nodes: the nodes array
- primitive.edges: the edges array
- primitive.height: 400
- primitive.layout: force
- animation: fade
- position.mode: flow

variables.name: conceptGraphJson
variables.description: JSON string with {nodes, edges} from conceptGraph impulse. If empty, LLM generates example data.

tasks.description: Render related concepts as a sortable table

prompt.template:
Render related concepts as a data table using render_ui.

Related concepts data (JSON): {{relatedConceptsJson}}

If data is empty or unavailable, generate example related concepts for {{conceptName}}:
- 6-8 related concept rows
- Columns: name (string), relation (string — e.g. 'is-a', 'part-of', 'uses', 'related-to'), strength (number 0-1)

Call render_ui with:
- primitive.type: data-table-v2
- primitive.columns: [{key: 'name', header: 'Concept', type: 'string'}, {key: 'relation', header: 'Relation', type: 'status'}, {key: 'strength', header: 'Strength', type: 'number'}]
- primitive.data: the rows array
- primitive.pageSize: 10
- animation: fade
- position.mode: flow

variables.name: relatedConceptsJson
variables.description: JSON array of related concepts from relatedConcepts impulse
